test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All wallet are bank.

All bank are vault.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some vault are bank.

(II): All wallet are vault.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0d40e73897828956a0dbfb18d520934c9e00dc4c0640a2d60c5de2987ec13d0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df80e31f0f21736605fe3dc42ff3870efc8b9b141852bd75830ca4cd220f0298.png] 

Conclusions:**

 (I): Some vault are bank → **Follow** (As all bank are vault. so, some vault are definitely bank).

(II): All wallet are vault → **Follow** (All wallet are bank and all bank are vault. so, all wallet are definitely vault).

Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2**”.
